_comment: TEMPLATE — fill in once the Android WebView APK exists, then this file must be served at https://YOURDOMAIN.com/.well-known/assetlinks.json (exactly that path, over HTTPS) for Android App Links to verify. Until this is correctly hosted with real values, clicking the password-reset link (or any https:// link to this site) on an Android device will open the system browser instead of the app — that's expected and harmless, just not the 'opens inside the app' experience. See the reference note in api/README.md for the full explanation of why a WebView-wrapper APK needs this (not something a web codebase alone can configure).

sha256_cert_fingerprints: REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_APK_SIGNING_CERT_SHA256_FINGERPRINT (get via: keytool -list -v -keystore your.keystore, or your WebView-wrapper tool's dashboard if using Median/GoNative/Appilix/etc.)
